snippet.title: Decomposition Teaser
snippet.description:
Happy Halloween everyone! 

We will be releasing more videos soon, but as a short introduction, Decomposition is an indie horror game that is currently being developed by students at Indiana University's Game Design program! 

In our game, you will play as Gareth Zeal as he tries to save his brother Gawain who’s slowly being lost to the rot taking over their family’s old church. Bring him the coffins he asks for and find VHS tapes to learn all your family secrets, just know you’re not alone.

Please subscribe to our channel to see more updates to our game as we continue it's development to release in May 2025. 

#indiehorrorgame #decomposition #analoghorror
